title: AI slop has found politics. Fake “news” channels are flooding YouTube with tales of blue-state collapse.
excerpt: AI-generated “news” channels are manufacturing fake blue-state-collapse stories on YouTube and pulling huge views. YouTube is struggling to keep up.
content_html:
For a while, AI slop was mostly harmless filler: fake animals, invented recipes, videos made to farm clicks. It has now found politics. A wave of AI-generated “news” channels on YouTube is manufacturing stories of economic collapse in Democratic-run states. Some are pulling hundreds of thousands of views.

The videos follow a formula. They claim big companies are fleeing California. Shops are running out of food. Teachers are quitting in droves. One channel, @MeganWright62, posted a false claim that Walmart was closing hundreds of California stores. CNN debunked it. In January, President Trump shared it anyway.

Much of the wave targets Gavin Newsom, a likely 2028 candidate. His team told Semafor it has worked with YouTube to remove more than 700 accounts since January. It used the platform’s “likeness protection” system, which flags a face used without permission. More than 100 carried false claims about Newsom and California.

The scale is the point. One channel, New York Reports, ran a video headlined “Wells Fargo LEAVES to Florida.” Stitched from unrelated clips, it drew about 300,000 views. Others falsely claimed Target had shut all its New York shops and that JP Morgan had quit the city. After Semafor flagged them, YouTube pulled several for breaking its spam rules.

The platform’s problem

YouTube says it is trying. Its chief executive, Neal Mohan, has called fighting AI slop a “top priority”. The company removed 1.6 million accounts for spam last year, and is tightening the rules on monetising repetitive, template-made videos. But the flood keeps rising. One study found more than 20% of the videos YouTube shows new users are low-quality AI content.

The trouble is the incentive. Slop exists to harvest cheap views and the ad money that follows. Pulling one channel does little when another appears the next day. It is the same dynamic seen elsewhere. LinkedIn added a “slop” button. Snapchat stopped recommending AI clips. Both are part of a wider retreat from features the industry rushed out.

This particular wave hits Democrats, but the picture is not one-sided. YouTube says it enforces its rules regardless of politics. Republicans have been quicker to use AI in campaign messaging. Democrats have faced backlash for it, as Andrew Cuomo did over an AI ad. And conservative media has made human versions of “blue-state dystopia” content for years.

Why it matters

Before the last US election, the fear was the perfect deepfake, a fake video convincing enough to swing a vote. That threat was largely overblown. The real problem turned out to be volume. Not one flawless fake, but an endless tide of cheap, plausible-enough clips. They are hard to trace and easy to believe at a glance.

Researchers argue the fix is not a blanket ban on AI content. Small tweaks to ranking, monetisation and eligibility could shift what creators make. New rules in Europe now force platforms to label synthetic media. For now, though, the slop still pays. And the people it targets are the ones hoping to run in 2028.

content_html_zh:
有一段时间，人工智能的废话大多是无害的填充物：假动物、发明的食谱、为农场点击制作的视频。 现在它已经找到了政治。 YouTube 上一波人工智能生成的“新闻”频道正在制造民主党执政州经济崩溃的故事。 有些浏览量达到数十万次。

视频遵循一个公式。 他们声称大公司正在逃离加州。 商店里的食物已经卖完了。 老师们纷纷辞职。 一个频道 @MeganWright62 发布了一条虚假消息，称沃尔玛将关闭数百家加州商店。 CNN 对此进行了辟谣。 无论如何，特朗普总统在一月份分享了这一点。

这波浪潮的大部分目标是加文·纽瑟姆(Gavin Newsom)，他可能是 2028 年的候选人。 他的团队告诉 Semafor，自 1 月份以来，他们已与 YouTube 合作删除了 700 多个帐户。 它使用了该平台的“肖像保护”系统，该系统会标记未经许可使用的面孔。 超过 100 条内容发表了有关纽瑟姆和加州的虚假言论。

规模就是重点。 纽约报道频道播放了一段标题为“富国银行离开佛罗里达州”的视频。 它由不相关的片段拼接而成，吸引了大约 30 万次观看。 其他人错误地声称塔吉特已关闭其在纽约的所有商店，摩根大通已撤离该市。 在 Semafor 对其进行举报后，YouTube 因违反垃圾邮件规则而删除了其中几人。

平台的问题

YouTube 表示正在尝试。 其首席执行官尼尔·莫汉 (Neal Mohan) 称打击人工智能溢出是“首要任务”。 该公司去年删除了 160 万个垃圾邮件帐户，并收紧了通过重复模板制作的视频获利的规则。 但洪水不断上涨。 一项研究发现，YouTube 向新用户展示的视频中有超过 20% 是低质量的 AI 内容。

麻烦在于激励。 Slop 的存在是为了获取廉价的观看次数和随之而来的广告收入。 当第二天出现另一个通道时，拉动一个通道几乎没有什么作用。 在其他地方也看到同样的动态。 LinkedIn 添加了一个“slop”按钮。 Snapchat 停止推荐 AI 剪辑。 两者都是业界匆忙推出的功能的更广泛撤退的一部分。

这一波特殊浪潮袭击了民主党，但情况并非是一面倒的。 YouTube 表示，无论政治如何，它都会执行其规则。 共和党人在竞选信息中更快地使用人工智能。 民主党人因此面临强烈反对，就像安德鲁·科莫对人工智能广告所做的那样。 保守派媒体多年来一直在制作人类版本的“蓝色国家反乌托邦”内容。

为什么这很重要

在上次美国大选之前，人们担心的是完美的深度伪造，一段足以左右投票的假视频。 这种威胁在很大程度上被夸大了。 事实证明，真正的问题是数量。 不是一个完美无缺的假片，而是无穷无尽的廉价、看似合理的剪辑。 它们很难追踪，却很容易让人相信。

研究人员认为，解决方案并不是全面禁止人工智能内容。 对排名、货币化和资格的小调整可能会改变创作者的创作。 欧洲的新规则现在迫使平台给合成媒体贴上标签。 但就目前而言，这种浪费仍然是值得的。 它的目标人群是那些希望在 2028 年参选的人。
